title: Nutella Indulgent Frittata
description: A rich and creamy frittata infused with the decadent flavors of Nutella, perfect for a brunch or breakfast treat.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, salt, and pepper.
Add uoozy and frittata to the bowl and stir until combined.
Drizzle Nutella into the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a greased 9-inch (23cm) pie plate.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Loosen the edges with a spatula and transfer to a serving plate.
